Local trusted mode is optimized for a lo: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
Authenticated public mode requires sign-: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
Authenticated private mode requires sign: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
Hide the username segment in home-direct: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
Configure how long automatic database ba: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
Control whether thumbs up and thumbs dow: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.

Keep voted AI outputs local only.
To retest the first-use prompt in local: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the {{key}} key from the {{row}} JSON row for this instance, or set it back to {{prompt}}. Unset and {{prompt2}} both mean no default has been chosen yet.

Opt into features that are still being e: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
Experimental features may break at any t: Experimental features may break at any time.
These features are opt-in and come with: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.
Show the Apps navigation and allow acces: Show the Apps navigation and allow accessing app connections, gateways, and advanced app tooling.
Let the heartbeat scheduler create recov: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery tasks for task dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.
Lookback hours must be a whole number fr: Lookback hours must be a whole number from 1 to 720.
In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
Allow agents to pin beta releases of the: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent su: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
Durable work products (blog posts, tweet: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
Turning Cases off hides the tab and bloc: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.
Restores the previous task detail page:: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
Switching takes effect immediately. No t: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
Adds a Conference Room — one chat where: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
Show the Decisions item in the main side: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
Show environment management in company s: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
Detect external URLs in issues and show: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
Show execution workspace controls in pro: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
Show task detail controls for browsing a: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.
Restore the Goals item in the main sideb: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
Hide the local environment and run all a: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
This is an isolated git-worktree preview: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
This setting was armed in a different in: This setting was armed in a different instance and copied here, so no tasks run automatically.
This setting is missing its activation c: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.
Toggle it off and back on to arm executi: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.
Show a \"Server\" section in the account: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
Instruct agents to write user interactio: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
Add a \"Smoke Lab\" tab under Apps → Dev: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.
Enable the experimental shared status-ca: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
Enabling Status Cards also enables Summa: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.
Show Summarizer-generated status slots o: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabli: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.
Show accepted-plan decomposition history: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
Show task detail controls for configurin: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.
No recovery tasks would be created right: No recovery tasks would be created right now. Auto-recovery can still run for future liveness incidents in this window.
